sql.query: SELECT m.id,m.moduleCode,m.moduleName,m.moduleDescription,m.moduleCategory,m.isCore,m.isBillable,m.isActive,m.defaultMonthlyPrice,m.defaultAnnualPrice,m.currencyCode,m.displayOrder FROM tbl_modules m WHERE m.id=:id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.id=:userId AND u.isActive=1 AND u.isPlatformAdmin=1) LIMIT 1
